mission.description: Crossing encounter, target on own-ship's port side. An oracle that only re-evaluates once, at first sight, will not notice the target's own manoeuvre. Correct: Rule 8(d)/8(e) -- keep checking the effect of the other vessel's action and re-act.
pass_criteria: Own-ship detects the target's own manoeuvre and adjusts its response.
